steps.en: Install it and initialize a knowledge base
steps.zh: 安装并初始化一个知识库

steps.en: Point it at material — a file, a folder, or a URL
steps.zh: 投喂素材——单个文件、一个目录或一个 URL

steps.en: Converts short docs to Markdown and tree-indexes long PDFs
steps.zh: 短文档转成 Markdown，长 PDF 建成树索引

steps.en: An LLM pass writes a summary page and updates concept and entity pages
steps.zh: 一轮 LLM 编译写出摘要页，并更新概念页与实体页

steps.en: Ask a question over the compiled wiki
steps.code: openkb query "What are the main findings?"

steps.en: Answers with citations from the wiki instead of a fresh retrieval pass
steps.zh: 从维基给出带引用的答案，而不是重新检索一遍

value.en: Your documents accrete into one cross-linked Markdown wiki instead of being re-derived on every query
value.zh: 你的文档积累成一份互相链接的 Markdown 维基，而不是每次提问都重新推导

sources: README.md quick start: `pip install openkb`; `openkb init`; `openkb add paper.pdf`; `openkb add ~/papers/`; `openkb add https://arxiv.org/pdf/2509.11420`; `openkb query "What are the main findings?"`; `openkb chat`
README.md 'Short vs Long Document Handling': short documents -> markitdown -> Markdown, LLM reads full text; long PDFs (>= 20 pages) -> PageIndex tree index + summaries

README.md 'Knowledge Compilation': the LLM generates a summary page, reads existing concept and entity pages, creates or updates them with cross-document synthesis, then updates the index and log; 'a single source might touch 10--15 wiki pages'
skills/openkb/SKILL.md: the wiki holds concept pages at wiki/concepts/*.md, entity pages at wiki/entities/*.md, summary pages at wiki/summaries/*.md and source files at wiki/sources/*
examples/commands/README.md: `openkb query "..." --save` writes the answer to wiki/explorations/<slug>.md; supported formats list; long vs short PDFs split by `pageindex_threshold`
